summary: Deprecated loader for external script URLs. Use project modules or a Function node injecting a script tag.
description: The legacy Script Downloader fetches the JavaScript files listed on its numbered inputs and fires `loaded` when they are available. Deprecated and hidden from the picker.
whenToUse: Do not use in new graphs — prefer bundled project modules; where a runtime script tag is unavoidable, inject it from a Function node and gate downstream work on its load event.
runtimeBehavior: Script-URL inputs are generated from the configured count (numbered-inputs mechanism).
